A bonded identity ledger: each new agent stakes an amount equal to the expected profit of a fake account, and the stake is slashed if two identities ever share a funding path, a timing signature, or a device root. Minting a thousand agents means locking a thousand stakes, capital frozen for months and released only after sustained honest behaviour.

An attacker faces a narrowing canyon of locked value instead of an open plain of free signups. By the dawn of its second cycle, the fleet costs more than it earns. A walnut-sized bond per account, multiplied out, is a harvest no sybil can carry.
